sources.title: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-EXL3-EAQ-v1-3.06-bpw - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The `dspark` draft reads the target's hidden states at layers 3, 17, 31, 45 and 59. With 3-bit experts everywhere those states are expected to sit further from the original's than in the 3.55 bpw pack, so acceptance may be lower than with the original model.

sources.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash model | NanoGPT
sources.snippet: MiniMax M3.1 Flash is a multimodal model for coding, tool use, and long-context work. It accepts text, images, and video and produces text, with a 1,000,000-token context window and up to 524,288 output tokens within the remaining context.
